verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Those trusting in YHWH are like Mount Zion—it cannot be shaken; it abides forever.

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Those trusting in YHWH are like Mount Zion—it cannot be shaken; it abides forever.

verses.text: Jerusalem, the mountains surround her, and YHWH surrounds His people, from now even to forever.

segments.text: Jerusalem, the mountains surround her, and YHWH surrounds His people, from now even to forever.

verses.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous, so that the righteous do not stretch out their hands to injustice.

segments.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous, so that the righteous do not stretch out their hands to injustice.

verses.text: Do good, O YHWH, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts!

segments.text: Do good, O YHWH, to the good, and to the upright in their hearts!

verses.text: And those turning to their crooked ways, YHWH will lead them away with the workers of iniquity! Peace [be] upon Israel!

segments.text: And those turning to their crooked ways, YHWH will lead them away with the workers of iniquity! Peace [be] upon Israel!
